module numerals.roman
  purpose: Convert integers from 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and back.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: The reasons a Roman numeral conversion can fail.
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  BadNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Glyph
  purpose: One Roman numeral symbol and the number it stands for.
  has value: Integer
  has letters: Text
end

function numeral_table() returns List of Glyph
  purpose: List every Roman symbol, including subtractive pairs, from largest to smallest.
  example: numeral_table().length() is 13

  return [
    Glyph(value: 1000, letters: "M"),
    Glyph(value: 900, letters: "CM"),
    Glyph(value: 500, letters: "D"),
    Glyph(value: 400, letters: "CD"),
    Glyph(value: 100, letters: "C"),
    Glyph(value: 90, letters: "XC"),
    Glyph(value: 50, letters: "L"),
    Glyph(value: 40, letters: "XL"),
    Glyph(value: 10, letters: "X"),
    Glyph(value: 9, letters: "IX"),
    Glyph(value: 5, letters: "V"),
    Glyph(value: 4, letters: "IV"),
    Glyph(value: 1, letters: "I")
  ]
end

function letter_value(letter: Text) returns maybe Integer
  purpose: Look up the value of a single Roman letter, or nothing if it is not one.
  example: letter_value("X") is 10
  example: letter_value("Z") is nothing

  let found be for each entry in numeral_table() where entry.letters is letter first
  let glyph be found otherwise return nothing
  return glyph.value
end

public function to_roman(number: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an Integer from 1 to 3999 to its Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, numerals, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if number is less than 1 or number is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: number)
  end
  let mutable remaining be number
  let mutable result be ""
  for each glyph in numeral_table()
    let times be remaining.quotient(glyph.value)
    set result to "{result}{glyph.letters.repeat(times)}"
    set remaining to remaining remainder glyph.value
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical upper-case Roman numeral to an Integer from 1 to 3999.
  tags: roman, numerals, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  let mutable total be 0
  let mutable highest be 0
  for each letter in numeral.characters().reversed()
    let value be letter_value(letter) otherwise fail with BadNumeral(text: numeral)
    if value is less than highest then
      set total to total - value
    otherwise
      set total to total + value
      set highest to value
    end
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with BadNumeral(text: numeral)
  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with BadNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  return total
end

test "numbers convert to numerals"
  check to_roman(2024) otherwise "" is "MMXXIV"
  check to_roman(444) otherwise "" is "CDXLIV"
end

test "numerals convert to numbers"
  check from_roman("MMXXIV") otherwise 0 is 2024
  check from_roman("CDXLIV") otherwise 0 is 444
end

test "invalid input gives a default"
  check to_roman(0) otherwise 0 is 0
  check from_roman("IIII") otherwise 0 is 0
end

  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an Integer from 1 to 3999 to its Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, numerals, conversion

  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"

  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical upper-case Roman numeral from I to MMMCMXCIX to an Integer.
  tags: roman, numerals, conversion
  see also: to_roman

  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
